cohort: The study included 562,039 multiparous women aged 15 to 44 years with singleton live births between 2015 and 2016.
finding: The study found that IPI rates can be reliably obtained from current year birth certificate data, confirmed the association of short IPI with preterm birth, and identified substantial hospital (0.8-9%) and regional (2.9-6.2%) variation in short IPI rates.
